title: color-interpolation
why: Standard SVG/CSS property shipping in all four engines, but missing from mdn-data, so VS Code reports it as an unknown property.

upstream.mdn-data: mdn/data#1121 (branch css/color-interpolation): adds the property to css/properties.json
upstream.vscode-custom-data: branch css/color-interpolation: turns on the property's disabled css-schema.json entry, so the keywords complete even though the spec syntax isn't keyword-only
upstream.mdn-content: after the mdn-data release: replace the page's hand-written formal-definition table with {{CSSInfo}}

properties.name: color-interpolation
properties.description: Specifies the color space used to interpolate between gradient stops and in color animations in SVG.

values.auto: The browser may interpolate in either the sRGB or the linearRGB color space.
values.sRGB: Interpolate in the gamma-encoded sRGB color space, the same as `in srgb`. This is the initial value.
values.linearRGB: Interpolate in the linear-light sRGB color space, the same as `in srgb-linear`.
